hypothesis: Relative action-conditioned geometry and shared per-enemy scoring transfer better than the rejected frozen temporal embedding selectors. Same data and utility; no larger-network assumption.
forecast: Before movement Gaussian noise, propose movement means mu+delta, compute frozen conditional aim means for this proposed mean movement, then frozen motor forecast. This is a mean-action feature forecast, not integration over noisy actions or a native future-state input.
tokens42: For each of8 observed enemy slots: type onehot21, current relative XYZ3, observed velocityXYZ3 and known1, facing known/sin/cos3, projected relativeXYZ3, current/projected distances2, distance change1, selected-target flag1, bbox known/halfwidth2, predicted own horizontal displacement2. Use all present enemies; unknown masks preserved. Project only own predicted XY; no unvalidated future enemy extrapolation.
wall26: Eight normalized changes of movement projection toward observed rays; eight changes of smooth projected wall proximity; expected forward/side2, analog change2, mean shift2, forecast displacement changeXY2, shift squared norm1, near-stationary flag1. These are features, never command masks or a rule controller.
score: Sum shared per-enemy score(candidate)-score(control), present slots only; plus linear26 wall/action score and trainable control beta. Normalize token/wall inputs only on available TRAIN actions/present slots, std>=0.1, clamp[-10,10].
utility: 4*alive_goal+0.25*kills-received/100-death; one observed conditional continuation, not expected Q.
loss: Same as preceding selector fit: per-context mean softplus(loser-winner) for accepted utility gaps>=0.05; equal TRAIN context weighting; plus0.05*(-log P(control)). Unknown actions not assigned negative labels.
initialization: Seed20261023 independently per model, final enemy layer and wall weights0; control beta=log495. Fixed500 Adam steps LR0.003 weight_decay0.0001 clip0.5 scores clipped20. No early stopping or endpoint search.
constant: Endpoint TRAIN mean probabilities, renormalized to each context availability; no development fitting.
harmful: Same as preceding selector: loses alive goal or preserves alive goal/kills with >=5 more received HP than control.
development_scope: Same4 internal development states reused for an explicitly exploratory representation iteration; passing is provisional and cannot substitute for fresh independent native evaluation.
source_frozen: All source NN/std/optimizer/checkpoint files unchanged. Frozen predictor and conditional-aim numerical forward only CUDA; fit only separate offline scorer.
next_if_pass: Choose highest useful gain over constant, then lower harmful mass, then smaller model. Require explicit native/CUDA likelihood/input contract acceptance and fresh comparison with source, constant and rules before quality claims.
next_if_fail: Stop these fits and do not play rejected endpoints. Next inspect label stability or action duration under a new protocol; do not keep tuning these development states.
